div.div:
شَنِيقٌ One whose origin is suspected; syn. دَعِىٌّ: a poet says, “أَنَا الدَّاخِلُ البَابَ الَّذِى لَا يَرُومُهُ
دَنِىْءٌ وَلَا يُدْعَى إِلَيْهِ شَنِيقُ
” [I am he who enters the door that the ignoble seeks not, and to which one whose origin is suspected is not invited]. (S.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, latter half.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
